insight: Seattle-based Humanly raised a $25M round in 2026, bringing total funding to ~$55.6M.
name: Humanly
tagline: Conversational AI recruiting that screens, schedules, and interviews candidates at scale.
description: Humanly is an AI recruiting platform that automates the high-volume, repetitive parts of hiring — candidate screening, interview scheduling, conducting interviews, reference checks, and re-engagement — across SMS, chat, email, voice, and video. It unifies ATS, CRM, and sourcing into one system and adds interview-intelligence notes, integrating with common applicant-tracking systems like Greenhouse, Lever, Bullhorn, and ADP. It also offers a job-seeker-facing product with AI coaching on interview prep, resumes, and negotiation.
edge: Built for high-volume/hourly hiring and unusually candidate-side too — it ships a job-seeker product with AI interview, resume, and negotiation coaching.
pros: Works across SMS, chat, email, voice, video
cons: No free tier or public pricing

references.title: Humanly raises $25M to put AI to work for job seekers, not just companies hiring
